attr.title: Wellenrennen
attr.desc: Experimental aarch64 PortMaster port of Wave Race 64: Recompiled, rendered with GLideN64 on OpenGL ES. Requires the user's own supported ROM.
attr.inst: Copy your own legally obtained Wave Race 64 (USA) (Rev A) .z64 ROM into wellenrennen/. No Nintendo ROM data is included.
